basis_statement: Authority boundary interpretation remains layered: tenant permission, delegation, authority-link readiness, human-gate evidence, and authority-of-record posture each emit their own stable reason vocabulary.

ACCEPTED.summary: Session authentication posture is sufficient for this boundary evaluation.

STEP_UP_PENDING.summary: This boundary requires stronger authentication evidence before progression.

STEP_UP_FROZEN.summary: Required step-up evidence is frozen into the evaluated boundary.

SATISFIED.summary: Tenant permission is satisfied for the evaluated action family.

MASKED.summary: Tenant permission is satisfied only under a masked presentation posture.

DENIED.summary: Tenant permission does not cover the evaluated action family.

NOT_REQUIRED.summary: No client delegation layer is required for this boundary.

SATISFIED.summary: Client delegation is live and usable for the evaluated boundary.

LIMITED.summary: Client delegation is usable but limited to a narrower live scope.

MISSING.summary: Required client delegation is missing for the evaluated boundary.

EXPIRED.summary: Required client delegation exists historically but is no longer live.

NOT_REQUIRED.summary: This boundary does not require an authority-link layer.

UNLINKED.summary: No usable authority link is available for the evaluated boundary.

LINK_INITIATED.summary: Authority linking has started but is not yet live for execution.

AUTHORISED_ACTIVE.summary: Authority link posture is live and active for the evaluated boundary.

AUTHORISED_LIMITED.summary: Authority link posture is live but scope-limited for the evaluated boundary.

TOKEN_INVALID.summary: Authority link posture is blocked by token or client-binding invalidity.

REVOKED.summary: Authority link posture is revoked and cannot support live execution.

EXPIRED.summary: Authority link posture is expired and cannot support live execution.

SUPERSEDED.summary: Authority link posture is superseded and cannot support live execution.

NOT_REQUIRED.summary: No human gate is required for this boundary.

PENDING_EVIDENCE.summary: A required human gate exists but its evidence is not yet frozen.

EVIDENCE_FROZEN.summary: Required human-gate evidence is frozen into the boundary.

NOT_APPLICABLE.summary: No authority-of-record outcome is required for this boundary.

NOT_EVALUATED.summary: Authority-of-record posture has not yet been evaluated for this boundary.

CONFLICT_UNCERTAIN.summary: Authority-of-record posture is uncertain or conflicts with internal workflow truth, so progression remains blocked.

CONFIRMED.summary: Authority-of-record posture is confirmed and does not block progression.
